canton_authority.name: Service de la population et des migrations (SPM) du canton du Valais
canton_authority.role: Cantonal authority responsible for reviewing and approving residence/work permit applications before federal (SEM) validation for non-EU/EFTA cases.
canton_authority.note: Confirm current official name, address, and contact details on the canton's official website before use.

commune_level.role: Every commune in Switzerland (including all Valais communes) requires new residents to register in person, typically within 14 days of arrival.

federal_layer.role: For non-EU/EFTA nationals, cantonal approval (SPM) is not sufficient on its own - SEM federal approval and quota availability checks are also required before a permit is finalized.
federal_layer.note: This two-layer (cantonal + federal) approval structure for non-EU permits is a general, stable feature of the Swiss system (LEI/AIG), not Valais-specific.

B.description: Residence permit (EU/EFTA: registration-based; non-EU: quota-subject, employer/canton tied).
B.valais_specific_note: Non-EU B permits in Valais are typically employer- and canton-specific; a job or canton change may require a new application, not just an update.

L.description: Short-term residence permit, tied to a fixed-term contract.
L.valais_specific_note: Renewal requires proof the contract still exists at time of renewal application.

G.description: Cross-border commuter permit - holder lives outside Switzerland (e.g. France, Italy) and commutes to work in Valais.
G.valais_specific_note: Requires proof of weekly return to the country of residence; tax treatment depends on bilateral agreements with the neighboring country.

C.description: Settlement permit (permanent residence) - no longer employer-tied, no quota restriction.
C.valais_specific_note: Eligibility depends on years of prior residence (varies by nationality/agreement) - verify current thresholds.

scenario_notes.JOB_CHANGE: For non-EU B/L permit holders, a new employer in Valais typically requires re-approval by SPM before starting the new role - verify whether the current permit's employer restriction applies.
scenario_notes.PERMIT_RENEWAL: Valais SPM renewal applications are commonly recommended to be submitted well before expiry (a specific lead time is NOT confirmed here - verify official guidance) to avoid a gap in authorized stay.
scenario_notes.FAMILY_TRANSFER: Family reunification (regroupement familial) has its own eligibility conditions (housing size/income thresholds may apply) separate from the primary permit holder's conditions - verify current thresholds with SPM.
scenario_notes.CANTON_CHANGE: Moving from Valais to another canton (or vice versa) requires de-registration from the Valais commune and registration in the new canton, plus that canton's own SPM-equivalent approval - it is not automatic.
scenario_notes.CONTRACT_TERMINATION: Loss of employment can affect permit validity for non-EU permit holders in particular - there is typically a limited grace period to find new employment or leave; verify current grace period rules with SPM Valais.
